profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.jobTitle: Full Stack Software Engineer | Applied AI & Agentic Workflows
profile.summary:
I’m a Full-Stack Software Engineer focused on building scalable web and mobile applications with technologies like React, Node.js, and AWS. I specialize in solving real-world problems through practical solutions whether it's developing predictive models, implementing cloud architectures, or improving user experiences.

Let’s connect if you’re looking for a software engineer with a strong track record of delivering impactful, user-focused solutions.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer | Applied AI & Agentic Workflows
positions.description:
Built AI-assisted PR review agent workflows to review code changes across database queries, state management, test coverage, implementation risk, and readability

Created agent workflows for automated test review, helping identify missing coverage, validate expected behavior, and speed up regression review across React/TypeScript changes

Constructed data-backed document workflow tools that surface ranked content suggestions from backend systems into an interactive React + TypeScript UI for proposal, product, sales, and technical teams

Modernized AT&T’s internal document-builder platform by migrating GoJS workflows to React Flow + Redux Toolkit, enabling intuitive drag-and-drop assembly of reusable content sections

Implemented GraphQL + Neo4j + Cypher-backed features defining document, template, section, and permission relationships; automated type-safe code generation to reduce schema drift

Re-engineered Markdown-to-document generation workflows across stored backend sections, editable UI representation, blob assembly, section parsing, and downloadable Word output

Implemented Mermaid diagram rendering inside document workflows, resolving Chromium dependency failures in a Dockerized enterprise proxy environment through an Edge-based container workaround

Added persona-based access and document workflow permissions by updating backend data relationships controlling which users could access, edit, or act on documentation assets

Improved reliability and performance across heavy document-building flows by debugging third-party library limitations, regex parsing edge cases, formatting defects, and targeted loading bottlenecks

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Optimized financial-insights and project-based web platforms built with React + Redux + Node.js, reducing front-end code 18% via modular hook refactor and accelerating feature delivery

Supported product and consulting projects, beginning with Spearmint, a technology accelerator product focused on modular React architecture, state management, and data workflow improvements

Built predictive-spending regression workflows using scikit-learn, scaling computation with Redis caching and batch pipelines for large transaction datasets

Deployed serverless architecture with AWS Lambda + S3 + API Gateway for Plaid API transaction processing, reducing infrastructure overhead and improving maintainability

Supported Spearmint project architecture by refactoring React state patterns, MongoDB schemas, Jest tests, and TypeScript aliases to improve modularity, test reliability, and developer onboarding

positions.title: Software Engineer - EHS II
positions.description:
Led the migration of a legacy local storage system and its associated APIs to a cloud-based database with RESTful architecture using Node.js, enabling real-time updates, faster data retrieval, and improved compatibility with modern web applications while eliminating manual syncing and reducing errors

Partnered with an external organization to develop an efficient UI for fieldwork, conducting iterative testing with field agents to ensure workflow alignment and enhance operational efficiency

Designed and implemented an LMS with functionalities for content packaging, sequencing, and user progress tracking, integrating SCORM modules to standardize learning content and enhance training

Redesigned the HCA Plan Check JS webpage, integrating interactive visualizations and server upgrades to streamline permit tracking and digital plan submission, resulting in significant permit pipeline optimization

Acknowledged by the HCA Director for outstanding leadership in mentoring staff and implementing training programs to enhance competency and readiness
